sql: SELECT university_id FROM university_year WHERE year = 2011 ORDER BY num_students DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.country_name FROM university AS T1 JOIN country AS T2 ON T1.country_id = T2.id WHERE T1.university_name = 'Harvard University'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM university_ranking_year T1 JOIN ranking_criteria T2 ON T1.ranking_criteria_id=T2.id JOIN university T3 ON T3.id=T1.university_id JOIN country T4 ON T4.id=T3.country_id WHERE T2.criteria_name='Teaching' AND T1.year=2011 AND T1.score>90 AND T4.country_name='United States of America'

SELECT DISTINCT T3.university_name FROM university_ranking_year T1 JOIN ranking_criteria T2 ON T1.ranking_criteria_id=T2.id JOIN university T3 ON T3.id=T1.university_id WHERE T2.criteria_name='Teaching' AND T1.year=2011 AND T1.score=98

SELECT DISTINCT T3.university_name FROM university_ranking_year T1 JOIN ranking_criteria T2 ON T1.ranking_criteria_id=T2.id JOIN university T3 ON T3.id=T1.university_id JOIN country T4 ON T4.id=T3.country_id WHERE T2.criteria_name='Teaching' AND T1.year=2011 AND T1.score<60 AND T4.country_name='United States of America'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM university_year T1 JOIN university T2 ON T1.university_id=T2.id JOIN country T3 ON T3.id=T2.country_id WHERE T3.country_name='Australia' AND T1.year=2011 AND T1.student_staff_ratio>15
SELECT CAST(T1.num_students*T1.pct_female_students AS REAL)/100 FROM university_year T1 JOIN university T2 ON T1.university_id=T2.id WHERE T2.university_name='Stanford University' AND T1.year=2011
SELECT num_students FROM university_year WHERE university_id = 268 AND year = 2013
SELECT country_name FROM country WHERE id = 66

SELECT T1.score FROM university_ranking_year T1 JOIN ranking_criteria T2 ON T1.ranking_criteria_id=T2.id JOIN university T3 ON T3.id=T1.university_id WHERE T3.university_name='University of Florida' AND T1.year=2014 AND T2.criteria_name='N and S'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.university_name='University of Ottawa' THEN T1.num_students END) AS REAL)/SUM(CASE WHEN T2.university_name='Joseph Fourier University' THEN T1.num_students END) FROM university_year T1 JOIN university T2 ON T1.university_id=T2.id WHERE T1.year=2013
SELECT score FROM university_ranking_year WHERE university_id = 68 AND year = 2015
SELECT id FROM country WHERE country_name = 'Cyprus'
SELECT AVG(score) FROM university_ranking_year WHERE university_id = 79 AND year BETWEEN 2013 AND 2015
SELECT COUNT(T1.criteria_name) FROM ranking_criteria T1 JOIN ranking_system T2 ON T1.ranking_system_id=T2.id WHERE T2.system_name='Shanghai Ranking'
SELECT DISTINCT T2.university_name FROM university_ranking_year T1 JOIN university T2 ON T1.university_id=T2.id WHERE T1.score < 50
SELECT T2.university_name FROM university_year T1 JOIN university T2 ON T1.university_id=T2.id ORDER BY T1.num_students - CAST(T1.num_students*T1.pct_female_students AS REAL)/100 DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.num_students - CAST(T1.num_students*T1.pct_female_students AS REAL)/100 FROM university_year T1 JOIN university T2 ON T1.university_id=T2.id WHERE T2.university_name='Emory University' AND T1.year=2011
SELECT T1.year FROM university_ranking_year T1 JOIN university T2 ON T1.university_id=T2.id WHERE T2.university_name='Brown University' ORDER BY T1.score DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.university_name FROM university_year T1 JOIN university T2 ON T1.university_id=T2.id WHERE T1.year=2015 ORDER BY T1.num_students DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T3.country_name, CAST(T1.num_students*T1.pct_female_students AS REAL)/100 FROM university_year T1 JOIN university T2 ON T1.university_id=T2.id JOIN country T3 ON T3.id=T2.country_id WHERE T1.university_id=23 AND T1.year=2011
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM university_ranking_year T1 JOIN ranking_criteria T2 ON T1.ranking_criteria_id=T2.id WHERE T2.criteria_name='Teaching' AND T1.score=40

SELECT DISTINCT T2.university_name FROM university_ranking_year T1 JOIN university T2 ON T1.university_id=T2.id WHERE T1.year=2015 AND T1.score*100 < (SELECT AVG(score)*28 FROM university_ranking_year WHERE year=2015)
